Aisha — thanks, and great to meet earlier. Below is the streamlined path we use for marketplace sellers; I’ll attach the PO field map and our onboarding form in the next message.

Short answers up front:
- PO template: Redwood accepts customer-issued POs but requires a mapped PO file that includes these minimal fields: PO number, billing entity legal name, billing address, invoice remittance email, tax ID (EIN/VAT), effective start date, SKU / product line (marketplace usage), unit quantity, unit price, and total. (See PO_Field_Map.xlsx)
- Wiring/ACH: We support ACH (US), wire, and card on file for hosted commitments. For ACH/wire we require the vendor's bank name, account number, routing number, and bank remittance email AND a signed vendor banking authorization form. Finance will validate payee name against legal entity on the W-9.
- Invoice cadence: Default is monthly in arrears, net 30. We can do net 45 or net 60 for large enterprise deals on approval. Please include usage detail per invoice (daily usage lines rolled up by billing period) — we prefer a per-SKU line-item so our marketplace billing can reconcile automatically.
- Docs: For US companies W-9 is required; for EU vendors we need VAT registration and a primary invoice contact. We also request a SOC 2 attestation if the vendor handles customer data at rest.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I will upload the PO_Field_Map.xlsx and Marketplace_Onboarding_Form.docx to the shared Drive and email the link.
2) Aisha, please return: signed Marketplace_Onboarding_Form + Helion's W-9 + vendor banking auth PDF.
3) Vanessa/Ben/Naomi: once documents arrive, can you run a quick validation (entity name vs W-9, bank check) and confirm a test invoice payment route?

I’ll set a 15-minute slot tomorrow at 9:30am PT for finance-to-finance if that helps speed this.

Thanks Aisha — adding finance notes from our side.

Quick checklist for Helion AP (to avoid delays):
- Legal entity exact name as it appears on W-9 (no DBA unless supported by tax docs).
- Preferred remit email (used to send invoice receipts and remittance advices).
- Bank account type (Checking/Savings), bank name, ACH routing (9-digit), and SWIFT/BIC for wire.
- Billing contact: name + phone + escalations email.
- PO acceptance: whether Helion requires countersignature on Redwood's standard marketplace T&Cs (if yes, we need to loop legal).

Field harmonization notes (we've attached PO_Field_Map.xlsx): 
- Use SKU tags: marketplace.sku (ex: rwd-inference:small-instance)
- Line-item metric should be usage_units with unit_of_measure (tokens/requests/hours)
- Tax handling: submit pre-tax amounts and provide tax lines separately so our billing engine can compute VAT/GST where applicable.

Ben/Naomi: once Helion uploads the signed onboarding form + W-9 + banking auth, please run entity verification and push the vendor into our test-pay vendor queue. We can process a $1 ACH test and then accept the first invoice.

Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
